source: Recorded from the default center_target_box ROI (2304x388 of a 3840x2160 FFNx window) and downscaled with INTER_AREA to 1280 px wide, the size the OCR stage receives.

limit_menu_lv3.png.source: Capture region of a 2000x1125 screenshot (Unknown 3 battle, limit menu open, cursor on a limit), not downscaled: 1200x202.

materia_sneak_attack.png.source: Field materia screen: the HUD words Attack and HP inside ability names.

materia_sneak_attack_2.png.source: Field materia screen: the HUD word Attack inside two ability names.

field_menu_status.png.source: Field main menu (party status: LV, HP, MP, Limit Level, Gil, Time). Its small, faint boxes change with the OCR's box scoring.

field_menu_status_fading.png.source: The same menu while it fades out (dimmed text). Its smallest box (a single digit) depends on the OCR's minimum box size.

prowler_wide_crop.png.source: Rows 35-165 of prowler.png (1280x130, aspect 9.8): wider than 8:1, so the OCR engine letterboxes it, as it does the default capture region of a 32:9 screen (about 12:1).
